proposals.before: On renchen day the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
proposals.after: On renchen day the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was made imperial uncle, exempted from Han-style obeisance, and addressed without taboo on his name.
proposals.reason: 皇太弟 is Chongyuan's title under Xingzong, not a statement that he is Daozong's younger brother; he is made 皇太叔 (imperial uncle).

proposals.before: On chou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
proposals.after: On yichou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
proposals.reason: Chinese 乙丑 is yichou; the translation dropped the stem 乙.

proposals.before: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guimao day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
proposals.after: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guiwei day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao (癸卯).

decisions.reason: 母曰仁懿皇后蕭氏 uses 懿 (yì), not 德; idiomatic Rende is a wrong romanization, and Renyi restores the posthumous title without other changes.
Literal likewise misreads 仁懿 as Rende; Renyi matches 懿 and keeps the rest of the sentence intact.

以皇太弟重元為皇太叔 names Chongyuan by the prior title 皇太弟 while appointing him 皇太叔; “the Emperor's younger brother” wrongly makes him Daozong's brother, whereas capitalized Imperial Younger Brother treats 皇太弟 as the title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以皇太弟重元為皇太叔

decisions.reason: Literal has the same kinship error for 皇太弟; rendering it as the title Imperial Younger Brother correctly pairs with the promotion to 皇太叔.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以皇太弟重元為皇太叔

decisions.reason: 六月乙丑 is the sexagenary day yichou; idiomatic “chou day” drops the heavenly stem 乙, and yichou restores the full date label.
癸未 is guiwei; guimao would be 癸卯. The repair corrects the branch without changing the appointment wording.
Literal likewise reads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct romanization of 未 versus 卯.
